      # @safety
      #   This cop is unsafe because it cannot be guaranteed that the receiver
      #   is an `Enumerable` or does not have a nonstandard implementation
      #   of `dig`.
      #
      # @example
      #   # bad
      #   x.dig(:foo).dig(:bar).dig(:baz)
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar).dig(:baz)
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar)&.dig(:baz)
      #
      #   # good
      #   x.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz)
      #
      #   # good - `dig`s cannot be combined
      #   x.dig(:foo).bar.dig(:baz)
      #
      class DigChain < Base
        extend AutoCorrector
        include DigHelp

        MSG = 'Use `%<replacement>s` instead of chaining.'
        RESTRICT_ON_SEND = %i[dig].freeze
        BYTE_ORDER_MARK = 0xfeff
        SINGLE_DIG_IGNORED_ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[
          block_pass forwarded_restarg forwarded_args hash
        ].freeze
        FORWARDING_ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[
          forwarded_args forwarded_restarg forwarded_kwrestarg
        ].freeze
        SPLAT_ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[
          splat kwsplat forwarded_restarg forwarded_kwrestarg
        ].freeze
        LITERAL_ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[
          sym str int float rational complex true false nil
        ].freeze
        CALL_ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[send csend].freeze
        REFERENCE_ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[lvar ivar cvar gvar const].freeze
        COMPOSITE_ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[array regexp hash kwargs].freeze
        INTERPOLATED_ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[dstr dsym xstr].freeze
        BOOLEANISH_ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[true false nil].freeze
        NUMERIC_ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[int float rational complex].freeze
        TEXT_ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[sym str dstr dsym xstr].freeze
        BLOCK_ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[block_pass block numblock lambda].freeze
        COMPOUND_ARGUMENT_TYPES = %i[begin kwbegin if case].freeze
        DIG_METHOD_NAME = :dig
        OPERATOR_METHOD_NAMES = %i[+ - * / % ** == === != < <= > >= << >> [] []=].freeze

        def self.dispatch_range_query(operation, *args)
          allocate.send(:execute_range_query, operation, *args)
        end

        def self.dispatch_comment_query(operation, *args)
          allocate.send(:execute_comment_query, operation, *args)
        end

        def self.dispatch_dig_query(operation, *args)
          allocate.send(:execute_dig_query, operation, *args)
        end

        def on_send(node)
          return if ignored_node?(node)
          return unless node.loc.dot
          return unless dig?(node)

          prepare_dig_chain_investigation(node)
          range, arguments = inspect_chain(node)
          @dig_chain_state[:offense_range] = range
          @dig_chain_state[:combined_arguments] = arguments
          return if invalid_arguments?(arguments)
          return unless range

          register_offense(node, range, arguments)
        end
        alias on_csend on_send

        private

        # Walk up the method chain while the receiver is `dig` with arguments.
        def inspect_chain(node)
          arguments = node.arguments.dup
          end_pos = node.source_range.end_pos

          while dig?((node = node.receiver))
            begin_pos = node.loc.dot ? node.loc.dot.begin_pos + 1 : 0
            arguments.unshift(*node.arguments)
            ignore_node(node)
          end

          return unless begin_pos

          [range_between(begin_pos, end_pos), arguments]
        end

        def invalid_arguments?(arguments)
          @dig_chain_state[:combined_arguments] = arguments
          return false unless usable_argument_list?(arguments)

          catalog_chain_arguments(arguments)
          forwarded_args_in_invalid_position?
        end

        def register_offense(node, range, arguments)
          @dig_chain_state[:offense_range] = range
          @dig_chain_state[:combined_arguments] = arguments
          replacement = build_collapsed_dig_call(arguments)
          message = format_collapsed_dig_message(replacement)

          add_offense(range, message: message) do |corrector|
            apply_collapsed_dig_correction(corrector, node, range, replacement)
          end
        end

        def range_between(start_pos, end_pos)
          execute_range_query(:range_between, processed_source.buffer, start_pos, end_pos)
        end
        def prepare_dig_chain_investigation(node)
          @dig_chain_state = {
            receiver: node,
            selector_kind: nil,
            argument_catalog: [],
            combined_arguments: nil,
            offense_range: nil,
            collapsed_replacement: nil,
            relocated_comments: [],
            argument_kind_summary: {},
            hops: [],
            chain_kind: nil,
            has_splat: false,
            has_forwarding: false,
            has_hash: false
          }
          record_chain_receiver(node)
          record_chain_selector_kind
          record_chain_hops(node)
          @dig_chain_state[:chain_kind] = receiver_chain_kind
          @dig_chain_state[:hop_count] = chain_hop_count
          @dig_chain_state[:mixed_safe_navigation] = mixed_safe_navigation?
        end

        def record_chain_receiver(node)
          @dig_chain_state[:receiver] = node
          @dig_chain_state[:receiver_source] = if node.receiver
                                                 node.receiver.source
                                               end
          @dig_chain_state[:outermost_dig] = outermost_dig_node
        end

        def record_chain_selector_kind
          receiver = @dig_chain_state[:receiver]
          loc = receiver&.loc
          kind = if loc.respond_to?(:dot) && loc.dot
                   dot_source = loc.dot.source
                   if safe_navigation_dot?(dot_source)
                     :safe_navigation
                   elsif dot_source == '.'
                     :dot
                   elsif double_colon_dot?(dot_source)
                     :double_colon
                   else
                     :other_dot
                   end
                 elsif loc.respond_to?(:selector) && loc.selector
                   :selector_only
                 else
                   :unknown
                 end
          @dig_chain_state[:selector_kind] = kind
        end

        def record_chain_hops(node)
          hops = []
          current = node
          seen = 0
          while current && dig_call_shape(current)[:dig] && seen < 100
            hop = describe_dig_hop(current)
            hop[:position] = seen
            hop[:terminal] = current.receiver.nil? || !dig_call_shape(current.receiver)[:dig]
            hops << hop
            current = current.receiver
            seen += 1
          end
          @dig_chain_state[:hops] = hops
          @dig_chain_state[:first_hop] = hops.first
          @dig_chain_state[:last_hop] = hops.last
          @dig_chain_state[:safe_hop_count] = hops.count { |hop| hop[:safe] }
          @dig_chain_state[:colon_hop_count] = hops.count { |hop| hop[:colon] }
          @dig_chain_state[:total_hop_args] = hops.sum { |hop| hop[:arg_count] || 0 }
          @dig_chain_state[:multiline_hops] = hops.any? { |hop| hop[:multiline] }
        end

        def mixed_safe_navigation?
          hops = @dig_chain_state[:hops] || []
          kinds = hops.map { |hop| hop[:safe] }.uniq
          kinds.size > 1
        end

        def chain_hop_count
          hops = @dig_chain_state[:hops] || []
          hops.size
        end

        def outermost_dig_node
          hops = @dig_chain_state[:hops]
          if hops && !hops.empty?
            hops[-1][:node]
          else
            @dig_chain_state[:receiver]
          end
        end

        def collapsed_argument_count
          catalog = @dig_chain_state[:argument_catalog]
          if catalog && !catalog.empty?
            catalog.size
          elsif @dig_chain_state[:combined_arguments]
            @dig_chain_state[:combined_arguments].size
          else
            0
          end
        end

        def catalog_chain_arguments(arguments)
          entries = []
          arguments.each_with_index do |argument, index|
            entries << describe_argument_entry(argument, index)
          end
          @dig_chain_state[:argument_catalog] = entries
          argument_kind_summary
          @dig_chain_state[:has_splat] = splat_like_argument?
          @dig_chain_state[:has_forwarding] = forwarding_argument?
          @dig_chain_state[:has_hash] = hash_or_kwargs_argument?
          @dig_chain_state[:collapsed_argument_count] = collapsed_argument_count
        end

        def forwarded_args_in_invalid_position?
          catalog = @dig_chain_state[:argument_catalog]
          return false unless catalog

          index = catalog.index { |entry| entry[:kind] == :forwarded_args }
          index && index < (catalog.size - 1)
        end

        def usable_argument_list?(arguments)
          return false unless arguments

          arguments.any?
        end

        def argument_kind_summary
          catalog = @dig_chain_state[:argument_catalog] || []
          summary = Hash.new(0)
          catalog.each do |entry|
            summary[entry[:kind]] += 1
            summary[:literal] += 1 if entry[:literal]
            summary[:forwarding] += 1 if entry[:forwarding]
            summary[:splat] += 1 if SPLAT_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(entry[:kind])
          end
          @dig_chain_state[:argument_kind_summary] = summary
        end

        def splat_like_argument?
          catalog = @dig_chain_state[:argument_catalog] || []
          catalog.any? { |entry| SPLAT_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(entry[:kind]) }
        end

        def forwarding_argument?
          catalog = @dig_chain_state[:argument_catalog] || []
          catalog.any? { |entry| entry[:forwarding] }
        end

        def hash_or_kwargs_argument?
          catalog = @dig_chain_state[:argument_catalog] || []
          catalog.any? { |entry| %i[hash kwargs].include?(entry[:kind]) }
        end

        def receiver_chain_kind
          hops = @dig_chain_state[:hops] || []
          if hops.any? { |hop| hop[:safe] }
            :safe
          elsif hops.any? { |hop| hop[:colon] }
            :constant
          else
            kind = @dig_chain_state[:selector_kind]
            case kind
            when :safe_navigation
              :safe
            when :dot
              :plain
            when :double_colon
              :constant
            when :selector_only
              :implicit
            else
              :unknown
            end
          end
        end

        def build_collapsed_dig_call(arguments)
          sources = argument_source_list(arguments)
          joined = sources.join(', ')
          replacement = case receiver_chain_kind
                        when :safe, :plain, :constant, :implicit, :unknown
                          "dig(#{joined})"
                        else
                          "dig(#{joined})"
                        end
          @dig_chain_state[:collapsed_replacement] = replacement
          replacement
        end

        def argument_source_list(arguments)
          catalog = @dig_chain_state[:argument_catalog]
          if catalog && !catalog.empty? && catalog.size == arguments.size
            catalog.map { |entry| entry[:source] }
          else
            arguments.map { |argument| argument_source_for_collapse(argument) }
          end
        end

        def format_collapsed_dig_message(replacement)
          stored = @dig_chain_state[:collapsed_replacement] || replacement
          format(MSG, replacement: stored)
        end

        def apply_collapsed_dig_correction(corrector, node, range, replacement)
          text = @dig_chain_state[:collapsed_replacement] || replacement
          corrector.replace(range, text)
          collect_relocated_comments(node)
          insert_relocated_comments(corrector, node)
        end

        def collect_relocated_comments(node)
          comments = execute_comment_query(:comments_in_range, node, processed_source).to_a
          @dig_chain_state[:relocated_comments] = comments.reverse
        end

        def insert_relocated_comments(corrector, node)
          comments = @dig_chain_state[:relocated_comments] || []
          comments.each do |comment|
            corrector.insert_before(node, "#{comment.source}\n")
          end
        end
        def describe_argument_entry(argument, index)
          metadata = collect_node_metadata(argument)
          {
            index: index,
            node: argument,
            kind: determine_argument_kind(argument),
            source: argument_source_for_collapse(argument),
            literal: argument_is_literal?(argument),
            forwarding: argument_is_forwarding?(argument),
            location: describe_source_location(argument),
            metadata: metadata,
            splat: metadata[:splat_type],
            send: metadata[:send_type],
            source_length: metadata[:source_length],
            contains_newline: metadata[:contains_newline]
          }
        end


        def collect_node_metadata(node)
          return {} unless node

          type = node.respond_to?(:type) ? node.type : nil
          children = if node.respond_to?(:children)
                       node.children
                     else
                       []
                     end
          child_count = children ? children.size : 0
          child_types = if children
                          children.map { |child| child.respond_to?(:type) ? child.type : child.class.name }
                        else
                          []
                        end
          method_name = if node.respond_to?(:method_name)
                          node.method_name
                        end
          receiver_present = node.respond_to?(:receiver) && !node.receiver.nil?
          arguments = if node.respond_to?(:arguments)
                        node.arguments
                      end
          argument_count = arguments ? arguments.size : 0
          hash_type = type == :hash
          array_type = type == :array
          send_type = CALL_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(type)
          literal_type = LITERAL_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(type)
          forwarding_type = FORWARDING_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(type)
          splat_type = SPLAT_ARGUMENT_TYPES.include?(type)
          parent = node.respond_to?(:parent) ? node.parent : nil

## Summary

**Bug**: In `inspect_chain` (lib/rubocop/cop/style/dig_chain.rb:92), the autocorrect range started at `node.loc.dot.begin_pos + 1`, assuming the connective dot is always 1 character. For safe navigation (`&.`) and `::` (2 characters), the range started one char too early, leaving a stray `&` (or `:`) before the collapsed `dig(...)` — producing `hoge & dig(:a, :b)`.

**Fix**: Use `node.loc.dot.end_pos` so the replacement range begins immediately after the connective regardless of its width.

**Validation**:
- `spec/rubocop/cop/style/dig_chain_spec.rb` + `single_argument_dig_spec.rb`: 38 examples, 0 failures (including the `x&.dig(:foo, :bar)&.dig(:baz, :quux)` → `x&.dig(:foo, :bar, :baz, :quux)` case)
- `spec/rubocop/cli/autocorrect_spec.rb`: 136 examples, 0 failures
- Issue reproduction `hoge&.dig(:a)&.dig(:b)` now corrects to `hoge&.dig(:a, :b)`
